answer.reason: Only the account of his birth tells something he experienced; the other verses list him as an ancestor or family head.

clauses.english: was born with a scarlet thread bound on his hand
clauses.quote: that had the scarlet thread upon his hand

doubts: JOS 7 and JOS 22:20 name Zerah only as Achan's forefather, and 1KI 4:31 names Ethan, so they add nothing about Zerah's own deeds.
NEH 11:24 and 1CH 9:6 only list his descendants.
